title: DeLonge already had ten advisers by November 2014

tellings.quote: But Peter Levenda, who was someone who worked closely with DeLonge, he said by the time he joined, which was November 2014, there were already 10 advisers.

plain: By November 2014 the musician Tom DeLonge already had ten advisers helping his UFO effort, according to the writer Peter Levenda, who worked closely with DeLonge and says that was the count when he joined. The researcher Jason Simosa tells Michels this, repeating Levenda. If true, it would mean DeLonge's network of insiders was in place well before it became public.
